title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant
Bedford Full-Time Permanent
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join a busy and professional legal team in Bedford.
This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious and motivated legal professional who is looking to develop their career within Commercial Property and become a valued member of an established team.
The Role
The successful candidate will provide support to the Commercial Property team and will have the opportunity to build on their existing legal experience while developing their knowledge and skills within this specialist area.
You will be working in a professional, fast-paced environment where attention to detail, organisation and a positive approach are highly valued.
About You
We are looking for someone who is:
- Positive, hardworking and professional
- Ambitious and driven to develop their legal career
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively
- A confident communicator with a professional manner
- Keen to learn and develop their Commercial Property knowledge
- Reliable, committed and able to work effectively as part of a team

A strong memory and excellent ability to retain information would be a real advantage in this role.
What We're Looking For
Previous experience within a legal environment is desirable, particularly experience supporting a Commercial Property team. However, applications from candidates with relevant legal administration or property experience who are keen to develop within Commercial Property will also be considered.
Why Apply?
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a professional legal environment and take the next step in your career, gaining valuable experience within Commercial Property while working alongside an experienced team.
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Location: Bedford
Hours: Full-time
Contract: Permanent
How to Apply
If you are ambitious, hardworking and looking for your next opportunity within Commercial Property, I would love to hear from you.
For a confidential conversation or to apply, please contact Hannah Stewart at ACS Staffing Solutions - (url removed)

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor- Temporary

Reports to: Branch Manager / Area Operations Manager
Location: Bedford
Department: Customer Service / Operations

Temp role

Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

As part of our ambitious growth strategy, our goal is to triple the number of repeat customers over the next five years. This role is central to achieving that ambition by ensuring every customer receives outstanding service, expert support, and a seamless experience from enquiry through to order fulfilment.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.

What You'll Be Doing
- Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
- Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
- Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
- Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
- Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
- Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
- Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
- Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
- Participate in stock cycle counting.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
- Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
- Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll help ensure:
- Customers receive consistently outstanding service.
- Orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
- Customer enquiries and complaints are resolved quickly and professionally.
- Strong customer relationships are developed and maintained.
- Sales opportunities are identified and passed to the relevant teams.
- The branch achieves improvements in customer retention, sales growth, and operational performance.
- You make a positive contribution to our team culture and business success.

title: Lettings & Property Coordinator
description:
Allstaff Recruitment are currently seeking a Lettings & Property Coordinator based in Kempston for an established Estate Agency.

Summary of the Lettings & Property Coordinator role

Salary: £28,000 - £29,000
Job Location: Kempston
Type of Contract: Permanent, Full time
Hours: Monday - Friday 09:00 to 17:00
The role
About the Role Goodacres Residential is looking for an organised, proactive and enthusiastic Lettings & Property Coordinator to join our busy residential lettings team in Bedford. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, has strong organisational skills and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service. Working closely with our lettings department and in-house maintenance team, the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the smooth day-to-day running of our established residential property portfolio

As the Lettings & Property Coordinator, your role will involve the following important duties:
- Assisting with the day-to-day coordination and administration of our residential lettings portfolio.
- Acting as a point of contact for landlords, tenants and contractors, responding to enquiries professionally and efficiently.
- Working closely with our in-house maintenance team to monitor, manage and ensure the timely resolution of property maintenance issues.
- Arranging routine property inspections and following up on any matters identified.
- Assisting with tenancy renewals, move-ins and check-outs.
- Coordinating inventories, check-in and check-out reports.
- Handling tenant enquiries and assisting with the resolution of tenancy-related issues.
- Assisting with property compliance, including monitoring safety certificates and relevant documentation.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date property and tenancy records.
- Providing administrative support to the wider lettings team as required. About You
- Previous experience in residential lettings, property management or a similar administrative role would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload

The experience required

As a successful Lettings & Property Coordinator, you will have the following:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional, friendly and confident approach when dealing with landlords and tenants.
- Good attention to detail and strong administrative skills.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- A proactive attitude with excellent problem-solving skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and property management software.
- A full UK driving licence is desirable.
